email.subject: Access Denied on s3:PutObject
email.body:
Error on my screen:
AccessDenied. User rahul.dev is not authorized to perform s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::finova-reports/*

WHAT HAPPENED
Rahul cannot upload to the finova-reports bucket.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. Open IAM, Users, rahul.dev and read the attached policies.
2. Open S3 and confirm the bucket finova-reports exists.
3. Explain which permission is missing.

DO NOT
Do not attach AdministratorAccess. Do not change the bucket.

REPLY WITH
PutObject is missing. The bucket is finova-reports. The fix is a scoped policy, not admin.

— Rahul

steps.instruction: Extract principal, action, resource from the error.
Decide: missing PutObject on finova-reports — route to bucket owner / scoped policy, not Admin.

reply.model_reply: rahul.dev lacks s3:PutObject on finova-reports. Request a scoped allow (or group policy) from bucket owner — not AdministratorAccess. — L1
